generalAbilities.name: Fearsense (Precise) 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: The betobeto-san is aware of all Frightened creatures within the listed range.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ominous Footsteps
defensiveAbilities.description:
60 feet. The betobeto-san's footsteps seem to draw ever closer, yet the source remains difficult to pinpoint. Each creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the betobeto-san must attempt a DC 29 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature becomes Frightened 1.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Invisibility
defensiveAbilities.description: The betobeto-san is Invisible unless within an area of bright light.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Step
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A bright light source reveals the betobeto-san.

Requirements The betobeto-san isn't already within an area of bright light.

Effect The betobeto-san Steps briefly into the Shadow Plane and then back again, appearing up to 30 feet away from where they began.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stepping Decoy
offensiveAbilities.description:
The betobeto-san Steps. They then create two illusory decoys of sound within 15 feet of them that mimic the sounds of their ominous footsteps.

These decoys act independently on the betobeto-san's initiative with 2 actions apiece. They can only Sneak or Stride, and they have a Speed of 35 feet. Use the betobeto-san's Stealth DC (typically 37) against attempts to Seek or disbelieve a decoy.

Each decoy lasts for 1 minute. Any existing decoys vanish if the betobeto-san uses this ability again.
